latest_release.body:
# S2Arm v0.6.10

这一版主修联机和声音：联机自动模式在 iPhone / iPad 上能发现房间，与 Switch 联机请在联机设置里选「与 Switch 联机」；Mac 插拔耳机、切换输出设备后声音不再一直慢半拍；Switch 2 游戏接上真实麦克风；同一个包里装了 36 位和 39 位地址的两款游戏时都能起。
*This release mainly fixes local multiplayer and audio: auto mode now finds rooms on iPhone / iPad (to play with a Switch, choose "Play with Switch" in the multiplayer settings); on Mac, sound no longer stays behind after plugging or unplugging headphones or switching the output device; Switch 2 games get a real microphone; a package holding two games with 36-bit and 39-bit address spaces can start both.*

## 新增
- **Switch 2 游戏的麦克风输入**：Mac 与 iOS 接上真实麦克风，开 / 关哼唱识别不再崩（#2151）。
  *Microphone input for Switch 2 games: Mac and iOS use the real microphone, and turning humming recognition on or off no longer crashes (#2151).*
- **iOS 分屏「自动」成为缺省**：竖着拿手机且上半区放得下画面时，自动上下分屏，按键都在下半区，不再叠在画面上；横过来照旧横屏排布（#2179）。
  *iOS split screen now defaults to "Auto": held upright with room for the picture in the top half, the screen splits top and bottom with all buttons in the lower half instead of covering the picture; in landscape the layout is unchanged (#2179).*
- **诊断码**：帖子里给的诊断码粘进电脑启动器，下次推那款时写进手机，生效一局后自动撤掉，iPhone 玩家也能开诊断。
  *Diagnostic codes: paste a code from an issue into the computer launcher; it is written to the phone with the next push of that game, applies for one session and then removes itself, so iPhone players can turn on diagnostics too.*
- **Apple ID 签名可以沿用导入的 .p12 证书**，不新建证书，也不撤掉 SideStore 的证书（#2015）。
  *Apple ID signing can reuse an imported .p12 certificate, without creating a new one or revoking SideStore's (#2015).*
- **Mac 启动器按钮样式统一**：同一排按钮形制一致，不再有胶囊破图（#2030，感谢 nevenhsu）。
  *Mac launcher buttons share one style: buttons in a row match and pill shapes no longer break (#2030, thanks to nevenhsu).*

## 修复
- **联机**：自动模式在 iPhone / iPad 上照常「发现 → 中继」，能搜到、能进同一房间；握手按会话路由，多网卡 / VPN 时选对网卡（#2134，感谢 maiga512）。与 Switch 联机请在联机设置里选「与 Switch 联机」。
  *Multiplayer: auto mode on iPhone / iPad discovers rooms and relays as before, so players can find and join the same room; handshakes are routed per session and the right network adapter is chosen with several adapters or a VPN (#2134, thanks to maiga512). To play with a Switch, choose "Play with Switch" in the multiplayer settings.*
- **声音**：Mac 插拔耳机或切换输出设备后，声音不再永久滞后（#1819）；切换音频路由后游戏不再中止；部分游戏刷新音频缓冲后宿主不再闪退；游戏设置外部音频流增益不再报错中止。
  *Audio: on Mac, sound no longer stays permanently delayed after plugging or unplugging headphones or switching the output device (#1819); games no longer abort after the audio route changes; flushing audio buffers in some games no longer crashes the host; setting the gain of an external audio stream no longer aborts.*
- **同一个包里装了 36 位和 39 位地址两款游戏时，选中的那款按它自己的地址窗口起局**，两款都能玩。
  *In a package holding a 36-bit and a 39-bit game, the selected game starts with its own address window, so both can be played.*
- **大内存池游戏显存占用下降**：大池改成整池一个缓冲后，旧的分块按期放掉，不再把 GPU 显存顶满后闪退（#2131，感谢 imneway）。
  *Lower GPU memory in games with large memory pools: after a large pool switches to one whole-pool buffer, the old chunks are released on schedule instead of filling GPU memory until a crash (#2131, thanks to imneway).*
- **补帧**：插值器重建时先等在途命令做完再释放，不再 GPU 缺页闪退。
  *Frame interpolation: when the interpolator is rebuilt it waits for in-flight commands before releasing, so it no longer crashes with a GPU page fault.*
- **S2Arm 更新后，本机现编过的着色器按单支重译，不再整批作废**；旧版出的「离线 0 支」iPhone 包会提示更新这款（#2158）。
  *After an S2Arm update, shaders compiled on this device are retranslated one by one instead of being thrown away as a batch; iPhone packages built by older versions with zero offline shaders now suggest updating the game (#2158).*
- **iPhone / iPad 读即时快照后不再卡在第一帧**（设备重启后也是，#2124，感谢 imneway）；即时存档与前后台切换的冻结互不干扰。
  *Reading a snapshot on iPhone / iPad no longer sticks on the first frame, including after a device restart (#2124, thanks to imneway); snapshot freezing and background freezing no longer release each other.*
- **换了装 App 的工具后，电脑不再一直提示「更新 iPhone 上的 S2Arm」**（#216

简体中文 · 繁體中文 · English · 日本語 · Español · Français

> [!NOTE] > **[s2arm.com](https://s2arm.com) is the official S2Arm website.** S2Arm is free and open source and never accepts donations; get S2Arm only from [s2arm.com](https://s2arm.com) or this GitHub repository. **Your own Switch games, running natively on iPhone, iPad and Mac.** Game code is rewritten to native ARM64 and runs directly on the device's processor, with graphics going straight to Metal. From 0.6.0 there is a single S2Arm app on your phone and every game lives in its library: in the Mac or Windows launcher, send games to your iPhone one by one and play. Platforms: iPhone / iPad (iOS / iPadOS 18 and later) · Mac (Apple silicon, macOS 15 and later) · Mac or Windows launcher · License: Apache-2.0 · **Bring your own games** [Download the launcher](https://s2arm.com) · [All releases](https://github.com/jhaizhou-ops/S2Arm/releases) · [Evidence](docs/validation/EVIDENCE.md)

## What's new in 0.6.0 ### One app for all your games Install S2Arm on your phone once, then add games one by one. Updating or renewing S2Arm never means installing your games again, and your saves stay. Sign with a free or paid Apple ID or a developer certificate, or sign it yourself and import it. ### Snapshots: save this moment, come back any time No need to wait for the game's own save point. In a game, tap the ◉ in the top-right corner to save the moment you're in; press and hold it and choose Go back to the saved moment to return. Next time, Continue from this moment at the top of the library takes you straight there. - Each game keeps only the latest snapshot; a new one replaces the old. - A snapshot takes storage on your phone (the size depends on the game). Press and hold to delete it and free the space, or turn snapshots off in Settings. - A snapshot only works on the device that saved it, and still works after you update S2Arm.

### One file, any of your devices Export any game as a .s2arm file and import it on another of your devices to play; the phone signs it by itself. Each game keeps one copy of its files, and Free up space shows what games, saves and snapshots take. ### Every shader, ready from the first play Shaders the game needs are prepared when you send it, so new areas no longer stutter the first time. Player diagnostics collected **26,809** shaders from 69 games that failed to compile on the device. Leaving out 278 damaged inputs that can't be read as shaders, **all 26,531** of the rest now compile. How it is counted: the rate covers only shaders that **had failed to compile** in player diagnostics; it is not a coverage rate for all shaders. Of the remaining 98, 91 were not shaders at all but memory read wrongly during capture (capture fixed), and the other 7 have been fixed at the root. Note: on iPhone, precompiled pipelines are generated only when you Push to iPhone with that iPhone connected. When exporting for self-signing (no iPhone connected) or with several iPhones connected, this version still compiles them the first time they are needed, as in 0.5. This will improve in a later version. ### Fixes, performance and graphics From 0.5.0 to 0.6.0 (how each number is counted is in the table): | | Number | How it's counted | |---|---|---| | Fixes merged | **344** | Fix commits merged into main after 0.5.0 | | Player reports handled | **156** | Feedback issues closed after 0.5.0 | | Community contributions | **126** | Pull requests from players and developers | | GPU render time | **−50%** | Deferred-lighting scene, 4.8–5.9 ms → 2.7 ms | | Build memory peak | **−35%** | Peak memory while building large games | Also: several kinds of shader problems fixed at the root, more reliable loading and saving, smoother frame generation, and steadier app install, signing and sending on Windows and Mac. Thank you to every player who reported a problem. ## Getting started 1. Download the Mac or Windows launcher from [s2arm.com](https://s2arm.com) and open it. 2. Import your own keys and games; put the base game, updates and DLC in one folder and import them together. 3. Connect your iPhone, click Install S2Arm on the S2Arm tile, first in the launcher's game library, sign in and sign with your Apple ID, and S2Arm goes onto your phone. 4. Pick a game and click Push to iPhone. 5. Open S2Arm on your phone and pick a game in the library. You can also play on the Mac itself: choose This Mac. Without a cable, export a .s2arm file and put it on your phone with AirDrop or the Files app. ### Self-signing with AltStore / SideStore Import games right on your phone, with no Apple ID sign-in on a computer and no new certificate: 1. In AltStore or SideStore settings, export your signing certificate and set a password. 2. Open S2Arm: gear → Signing certificate → Import .p12…, pick the certificate and enter the password. 3. Then put .s2arm and .img files (exported from your computer or shared by a friend) into S2Arm's Import Here folder, and play. Note: manage each Apple ID from AltServer on only one computer. Using two makes them revoke each other's certificates, and AltStore shows "Multiple AltServers". Before the 7 days run out, just tap Refresh All in AltStore; nothing else to do in S2Arm. ### Upgrading from 0.5 The games, saves and game data already on your phone all stay. No exporting again, no sending game data again. 1. On a Mac, sign in with your Apple ID once in S2Arm (0.5 used the account signed in to Xcode; 0.6.0 signs in inside S2Arm. Windows players skip this step). 2. Connect your phone and click Update S2Arm on the S2Arm tile, first in the game library. Your saves are backed up to the computer first, then the new app goes on over the old one (same Apple ID). 3. Right after that, the same page says how many old games on this phone need one update before they play; they are all checked, so click Update these N games (or later, check the games marked Update suggested in the dashboard and click Update selected). One game at a time, it brings the saves back to the computer, pushes the new program and sends only the resources that changed; each game takes about 1–2 minutes. For games whose shader library was built by the old version, the computer rebuilds it with the new one in this step (the game's files or its Mac version must still be in your library); the first time takes from a few minutes to a few tens of minutes. You don't need S-grade optimization for this. On a Windows PC without the Metal developer tools, this step sends the old library and says why; the game still plays, and once you install them under Get this PC ready, push again to get the new library. Until step 3 is done those games show Update once on your computer on the phone and won't open, but they aren't gone. Games installed from another computer are listed on a separate line on the same page; update them on that computer. If you used Free up space to delete a game's iPhone resource pack, build that game's iPhone package again. If you sign the app yourself with AltStore or similar: connect the phone, click Install S2Arm on the S2Arm card first in the game library, and on the page saying you aren't signed in with an Apple ID, click Export for self-signing instead (no iPhone needed) to get the new S2Arm.ipa; install it over the old one with AltStore; import your signing certificate (SideStore: gear → Signing certificate → Get from SideStore in S2Arm; AltStore: export it in AltStore settings, then Import .p12…); finally click Send selected to iPhone in the console, or click Export for self-signing on each game and put its .s2arm and .img into Import Here. ## Let an AI drive Both the Mac and Windows launchers expose a control interface, `s2armctl`. An AI assistant can import games, build, install, follow progress and read errors, and every step shows up in the launcher window. A companion self-check, self-fix and feedback toolkit lets the AI find a problem, apply the documented fix, and, when it cannot, package a diagnostic bundle for you to file. Watch an AI diagnose and fix a real problem end to end: [Evidence](docs/validation/EVIDENCE.md#ai-at-the-wheel) ### Have an AI do it for you Send this to your AI assistant (it needs to be able to run commands on your computer): > Please read https://github.com/jhaizhou-ops/S2Arm/blob/main/launchers/macos/skill/s2arm-operator/SKILL.md and then help me install my Switch game on my iPhone. It moves forward with a few commands, and you can watch every step in the launcher window: ```bash /Applications/S2Arm.app/Contents/Resources/s2armctl start # open and connect to the launcher /Applications/S2Arm.app/Contents/Resources/s2armctl next # what to do now, who does it, and why /Applications/S2Arm.app/Contents/Resources/s2armctl diag export ~/Desktop/S2Arm-diagnostics.zip # export a diagnostic bundle if it cannot fix a problem ``` Anything only you can do (system permission prompts, signing in with your Apple ID, tapping Trust on your phone), the AI stops and asks you to do. On Windows, use `s2armctl.cmd` in the launcher folder with the same commands. Windows builds iPhone / iPad packages only, so report problems inside a game from the phone: tap the report button to the right of the gear at the top left in game and say which game, what you did and what you saw. The diagnostic bundle is uploaded with it. **Something wrong inside a game** (graphics, frame rate, stutter, crashes)? Send your AI: > Please read https://github.com/jhaizhou-ops/S2Arm/blob/main/skills/player-game-triage/SKILL.md . My S2Arm game has this problem: . Check the settings first, then collect diagnostics; if you can change code, fix it at the root and open a PR, otherwise help me file an issue. ## Tested at scale **211** games surveyed with a **95%** first-try build success rate. **4,700+** test runs on real iOS devices and **1,000+** on macOS. [Evidence](docs/validation/EVIDENCE.md#tested-at-scale) ## Fast, smooth, and easy on the battery On a 16 GB MacBook Air (M3), from importing a game to a finished iPhone build, completely cold: | Game | Game files | Shaders | Build time | |---|---|---|---| | A 23.5 GB action RPG | 23.5 GB | 1,222 | **6.4 min** | | A 12.0 GB life-sim game | 12.0 GB | 9,315 | **8.6 min** | | A 17.5 GB open-world game | 17.5 GB | 26,999 | **34 min** | A Switch 2 game, measured on an iPhone 17 Pro Max: a **full 60 fps** while the phone is cool, **37–43 fps** once sustained load has heated it up, at about **0.15 J per frame**. [Evidence](docs/validation/EVIDENCE.md#speed-and-efficiency) ## Platforms | Platform | Support | |---|---| | iPhone / iPad | iOS / iPadOS 18 and later; every game in one S2Arm app | | Mac | Apple silicon, macOS 15 and later; the launcher installs the app and sends games, and you can also play on the Mac | | Windows | Graphical launcher: install the app, send games, export .s2arm | [Evidence](docs/validation/EVIDENCE.md#platforms) ## Downstream deep ports Some games have a deep port made specially by the community. S2Arm recognizes these games: on export it shows a page explaining the option, and you can switch to the downstream project's route (importing, packing and installing are still buttons in S2Arm, with the downstream project's implementation underneath) or keep the standard route. The registry is [`pack/downstream/schemes.json`](pack/downstream/schemes.json); the contract between the two is the downstream project's document. | Route | Project | Devices | Contract | |---|---|---|---| | D2R-Mobile | [jhaizhou-ops/d2r-mobile](https://github.com/jhaizhou-ops/d2r-mobile) | iPhone / iPad (iOS 26 and later; Android and HarmonyOS in progress) | [docs/S2ARM.md](https://github.com/jhaizhou-ops/d2r-mobile/blob/main/docs/S2ARM.md) | ## Honest boundaries S2Arm runs 64-bit (AArch64) games. Apple silicon cannot execute 32-bit ARM code, so 32-bit games are outside what S2Arm supports, as are games that need a 36-bit address space. ## Development [Contributing](CONTRIBUTING.md) · [AI collaboration policy](LLM_POLICY.md) · [Diagnosis and root-fix skills for AI](skills/) · [Report a problem](https://github.com/jhaizhou-ops/S2Arm/issues) · [Third-party licenses](THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md) ## Thanks S2Arm stands on the shoulders of its community. - **Co-developers**: thank you to everyone who has opened a pull request or issue in this project. ## 0.6.0 有什么新东西 ### 一个 App，装下所有游戏 手机上只装一次 S2Arm，以后游戏一款一款推进去。S2Arm 更新、续签，都不用把游戏重装一遍，存档也都在。签名可以用免费或付费的 Apple ID、开发者证书，也可以自己签名后导入。 ### 即时快照：存下这一刻，随时回来 不用等游戏自己的存档点。游戏里轻点右上角的 ◉，当下这一刻就被存下来；长按它，选「回到上次存下的这一刻」就回去。下次打开游戏库，最上面的「从这一刻继续」点一下直接进。 - 每款游戏只留最新的一份，新存的会盖掉旧的。 - 一份快照会占用手机空间（大小因游戏而异），长按就能删除、腾出空间；设置里也能关掉。 - 快照只在存下它的那台设备上能用；S2Arm 更新之后照样能回去。

### 一个文件，换台设备接着玩 每款游戏可以导出成 .s2arm 文件，放到你的另一台设备上导入就能玩，手机会自己完成签名。一款游戏只占一份空间，游戏、存档、快照各占多少，在「释放空间」里一目了然。 ### 着色器全覆盖：第一次玩就流畅 推游戏时就把游戏要用的着色器备好，第一次进新场景不再卡一下。玩家诊断里收集到 69 款游戏在设备上现编失败的着色器共 **26,809** 个：除去 278 个本身已损坏、读不成着色器的输入，其余 **26,531** 个现在**全部**能编出。 口径：这个比例只算玩家诊断里**历史上编译失败过的**着色器，不是全部着色器的覆盖率。剩下的 98 个里，91 个是抓取时读错了内存、本来就不是着色器（抓取已修），另外 7 个已根修。 注意：iPhone 上的预编管线要在电脑连着这台 iPhone「推到 iPhone」时才会生成；导出自签包（不连手机）或同时连着多台 iPhone 时，这一版仍是第一次遇到时现编，和 0.5 一样，后续版本会改进。 ### 修复、性能和画面 从 0.5.0 到 0.6.0（口径见下）： | | 数字 | 口径 | |---|---|---| | 修复合入 | **344** 项 | 0.5.0 发布后合入 main 的修复提交 | | 玩家反馈处理 | **156** 条 | 0.5.0 发布后关闭的反馈帖 | | 社区贡献合入 | **126** 份 | 来自玩家与开发者的 PR | | GPU 渲染耗时 | **−50%** | 延迟光照场景，4.8–5.9 ms → 2.7 ms | | 出包内存峰值 | **−35%** | 大型游戏出包时的内存峰值 | 另外还有：多类着色器问题根修、读档存档更可靠、补帧更顺，Windows 和 Mac 上装 App、签名、推送更稳。感谢每一位反馈问题的玩家。 ## 开始使用 1. 从 [s2arm.com](https://s2arm.com) 下载 Mac 或 Windows 启动器，打开即用。 2. 导入你自己的密钥和游戏；本体、更新和 DLC 放在同一个文件夹里一次导入。 3. 连上 iPhone，在启动器游戏库第一格的「S2Arm」里点「安装 S2Arm」，用你的 Apple ID 登录、签名，把 S2Arm 装到手机上。 4. 选一款游戏，点「推到 iPhone」。 5. 在手机上打开 S2Arm，在游戏库里选游戏开玩。 在 Mac 上也能直接玩：选「这台 Mac」即可。不连手机的话，可以导出 .s2arm 文件，用 AirDrop 或「文件」App 放到手机上导入。 ### 用 AltStore / SideStore 自签 不用电脑登录 Apple ID、也不用新建证书，手机上就能导入游戏： 1. 在 AltStore 或 SideStore 的设置里「导出签名证书」，设一个密码。 2. 打开 S2Arm：齿轮 →「签名证书」→「导入 .p12…」，选这份证书，输入密码。 3. 之后把电脑导出的或朋友分享的 .s2arm 和 .img 放进 S2Arm 的「放这里导入」，就能玩。 注意：同一个 Apple ID 只在一台电脑的 AltServer 上管理；两台电脑都用会互相作废证书，AltStore 会弹「Multiple AltServers」。7 天到期前在 AltStore 点「Refresh All」即可，S2Arm 里不用再做什么。 ### 从 0.5 升级 你手机上原来的游戏、存档和游戏数据都会留着，不用重新出包，也不用重传游戏数据。 1. Mac 玩家先在 S2Arm 里用 Apple ID 登录一次（0.5 用的是 Xcode 里的账号，0.6.0 改成直接在 S2Arm 里登录；Windows 玩家不用多做这一步）。 2. 连上手机，在游戏库第一格的「S2Arm」里点「更新 S2Arm」：会先把各款存档备份到电脑，再换成新 App。用同一个 Apple ID 就是覆盖安装。 3. 装完后同一页会提示「这台手机上有 N 款旧游戏，要更新一次才能玩」，默认全勾，点「更新这 N 款」（之后也可以在总控台勾上标着「建议更新」的游戏，点「更新所选」）：每款依次把存档拉回电脑、推上新版程序，资源只补变了的，每款约 1–2 分钟。着色器库还是旧版做的游戏，电脑会在这一步按新版重做（要游戏库里还有这款的游戏文件或 Mac 版），第一次要几分钟到几十分钟。不用点 S 级优化。Windows 电脑没装 Metal 开发工具时，这一步照推旧库并写明原因，游戏照样能玩；在「准备这台电脑」里装好后再推一次就换上新库。 第 3 步做完之前，这些游戏在手机上会显示「在电脑上更新一次」，点不进去，但没丢。别的电脑装的游戏，同一页会另起一行列出，到装它们的那台电脑上更新。用「释放空间」删过 iPhone 资源包的游戏，要重新打这款的 iPhone 包。 用 AltStore
